notes.title: Frontline Fury - Trenches, Mud & Blood Demo OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The battle begins now! The demo for Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood is officially live on Steam! Step into the boots of a soldier fighting in the gritty, war-torn battlefields of World War II, where every moment is a fight for survival.


 Intense Top-Down Combat – Experience the chaos of war with brutal, fast-paced gameplay.
 Survive the Trenches – Navigate the mud-soaked battlefields, dodge artillery fire, and take cover in the trenches.
 Tactical Shooting – Every bullet counts. Choose your weapons wisely and adapt to the fight.
 Relentless Warfare – Face waves of enemy soldiers in intense, high-stakes combat scenarios.


Inspired by real WWII battles, Frontline Fury: Trenches, Mud & Blood delivers an action-packed experience where quick reflexes and strategic thinking determine survival. Can you withstand the horrors of war and complete your mission?

The fight starts now – download the demo and join the frontline!

Play the Demo on Steam

notes.title: Moonshine Maniacs will become free2play ...
notes.content:
It's 2 months since we released our first Indie game Moonshine Maniacs on steam and to be honest, we thought it would run better. So one of the biggest issues of MSM is the lack of players and to solve this, we had two options ...

1. Spend more money into advertisement
2. Make it free2play

We want people to see what we wanted to do here, we don't want to compete with other big titles or strongly known PVP games. All we aimed for was having a good time where you can relax and shoot some cowboys between the eyes. Of course, it's kind of an old school thinking of games, but its what we ourselves enjoy from time to time.

So our next step will wait if we can build a community who likes moonshine maniacs and see if we can work further on it, to move it there where we wanted it to be.

So if you feel to keep yourself up to date and look for someone to compete with, feel free to join our Discord.

See you at highnoon, cowboy! :D
